demandEvidence.chore: Handle customer messages received through Facebook Messenger in a Make scenario.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I am building a scenario in Make.com to handle customer messages received through Facebook Messenger.

ease.reason: A student can test a first-pass summary and reply draft on operator-supplied sample messages; no implementation reference supports message intake or drafting.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small professional service providers handling Messenger inquiries may pay for help preparing replies; this post establishes no buyer intent or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can summarize sample messages and draft replies for review; Messenger connection, image handling, accuracy, and usefulness remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed loop could prepare drafts from supplied messages, but no source supports integration or automation; a person must interpret and approve every reply.

evidence.reason: The post explicitly identifies customer messages received through Facebook Messenger, but gives no message types, frequency, reply rules, or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: a small experiment is assessable from the stated Messenger customer-message chore, but implementation support, message details, repeat frequency, and buyer intent are absent; the provisional mean is 4.4.
